## Source: amazon-inspector (2a37bdcb4fb409ae0b0b3a3da4eae357a804bb34ca6ae119b00bb9855d2a6b29)
package.json declares `"libsignal": "github:tenka-san/libsignal-node"`, resolving the dependency from a GitHub repository with no commit SHA, tag, or version pin. On `npm install`, the default branch HEAD of that repository is fetched and installed, including any lifecycle scripts it defines, with no integrity check. The owner of that third-party repository can change the contents at any time, so the code that ultimately runs on an installer's machine is controlled by the repository owner rather than by the published npm artifact. The dependency source is a third-party GitHub account that is not a registry version range and not pinned to an immutable ref.
